suggestions.assertion: Every implementation task ends with a reference to /test-driven-development skill
suggestions.reason: The assertion is satisfied by a boilerplate line appended to each task. A stronger check would verify the task's test scaffold is non-trivial (e.g., has at least one negative/edge-case test) rather than just checking the footer line exists.

No assertion checks that the plan's registration approach is architecturally correct — e.g., that FormatParserResolver is injected via the DI container rather than instantiated inline. Task 6 does cover container wiring, but no assertion validates this critical architectural detail.

eval_feedback.overall: All 9 assertions pass with solid evidence. The plan is thorough and well-structured. Consider adding assertions that check architectural correctness of the DI wiring, not just presence of content.
